provenance.how_to_verify: Open Bluebook R. 14.7 and check the `Memorandum of January 20, 2021, 86 Fed. Reg. 7225 (Jan. 26, 2021)` form.

positive.text: See Memorandum of January 20, 2021, 86 Fed. Reg. 7225 (Jan. 26, 2021).
The policy was announced in a Presidential Memorandum of Aug. 25, 2017 to the Secretary.
Compare Memorandum of Jan. 26, 2021, 86 Fed. Reg. 7,487 with Presidential Memorandum of March 6, 2017.

negative: The memorandum of law was filed January 20, 2021.
A Memorandum of Understanding was signed on Jan. 26, 2021.
See the Memorandum of January 20, 2021, from counsel.

note: A bare `Memorandum of <date>` is too common in litigation to match alone, so it must be followed by its Fed. Reg. cite (which this rule then absorbs) or say `Presidential`. No authority_key: the date alone does not identify one memorandum.
